items.placementTarget: Read and apply. The sticker it points at goes on rulebook page 8 under setup step 4.
items.text: As a reminder to place Hollow Men for the last 3 cards, place this sticker on page 8, as shown, under step 4 of the setup.

rules: Place the Hollow Men icon (item 01) on page 8, under setup step 4.
The printed diagram is the step-4 infection flip: São Paulo, Lagos, Istanbul, Washington, London, New York, Jacksonville, Cairo, and a second São Paulo, with a supply cube being removed.
A red arrow points at the Hollow Men icon on the right of that diagram.
mechanics.effect: Tells you where the Hollow Men reminder sticker goes.

summary: A Hollow Men icon sticker and the instruction to stick it on rulebook page 8, under setup step 4, as the reminder for the last 3 infection cards.
